payload.posture: Read Acts 17:22–31 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states paul begins from an unknown altar and contrasts creator, human-made spaces, nations, searching, and judgment. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
